outcome: Prevalence and risk factors of postnatal pelvic organ prolapse (POP)
finding: This study found a high prevalence of mild to moderate POP in premenopausal primiparous women, with significant associations found between POP and collagen levels, history of collagen disease, childbirth-related pelvic floor trauma, and cesarean section being protective against cystocele and rectocele.
mod_finding: Cesarean section was significantly protective against cystocele and rectocele but not for uterine prolapse.
